issues.legal_issue: The mandatory three-month payment condition applies to a landlord’s ejectment decree even when the decree does not expressly state the deadline.
material_facts: A landlord brought a suit to evict tenants from land on which a tenant had constructed a building.

The court determined the compensation payable for the building and passed a decree requiring payment before the landlord could obtain possession, but the decree did not expressly state the three-month payment deadline.
The landlord did not pay the compensation into court within three months of the decree.
issues.conclusion: The omission of the deadline from the decree did not prevent the statutory consequence from applying; the landlord’s suit stood dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 4(1) and 4(4) of the Madras City Tenants’ Protection Act, 1921, the landlord’s payment of the compensation into court within three months is a mandatory condition, and failure to pay within that period requires dismissal of the suit. The reference in section 4(4) to a decree under section 4(1) identifies the decree whose date starts the period; it does not require strict compliance with the decree’s form. This construction gives effect to the Act’s purpose of protecting tenants who built on leased land. No earlier cases are relied upon in the judgment.

rule.if: ejectment_suit_by_landlord and compensation_determined and decree_omits_payment_deadline and compensation_not_paid_within_three_months

predicates.ejectment_suit_by_landlord: A landlord brought a suit seeking to evict a tenant.
predicates.compensation_determined: The court determined compensation payable to the tenant for improvements on the land.
predicates.decree_omits_payment_deadline: The decree did not expressly state the deadline for the landlord to pay the compensation.
predicates.compensation_not_paid_within_three_month: The landlord did not pay the compensation into court within three months of the decree.

issues.definition: When a landlord seeks eviction, the court determines compensation, the decree omits the payment deadline, and the landlord fails to pay within three months, the suit is dismissed.
